IF( AND( ISPICKVAL (Status__c, "Open"), ISPICKVAL (Type__c,"Quote"), Today() - EffectiveDate <=3),"Open", IF( AND( ISPICKVAL (Status__c, "Open"), ISPICKVAL (Type__c,"Quote"), Today() - EffectiveDate >=3), "Expired",
